changes.value: Talking to a person is part of the flow: WhatsApp click-to-chat and call buttons on product and quote pages, and a quote thread that carries messages, not just a form.
A dedicated path for institutions: request a quote from a cart or a list, upload a requirements sheet, get a quote thread, then approve it into an order. Repeat orders reuse past quotes.
Home, category, product, search results, cart, checkout, quote request, quote thread, account (orders, saved lists, addresses), order tracking, buying guides, about and contact, FAQ.
Large photo with zoom, pack size and unit price, stock status, safety and usage notes, downloadable spec or safety data sheet where relevant, WhatsApp button, and add-to-cart plus add-to-quote.
Skeleton loaders, helpful empty states (empty cart suggests categories), and plain errors that say what happened and how to fix it, with a retry.

notes: I like the way supply master visuals is. Dont copy the content but copy the visual style and the way the sections are arranged
